            and sequences[0] < sequences[1],
evidence.reason: The proof helper validates only the runtime fields and internal ordering of the two completion entries; it never compares the completion sequences or invocation IDs against a pre-switch snapshot. The caller passes only the prior runtime, so a stale completion pair already present before the switch can satisfy the check. The suggested baseline comparison is a correction to existing proof intent, not a new requirement.
